name: Recraft V4
description: Recraft's design model: text rendering, brand colours, vectors. Text to image only on fal, so it works in "Generate new", not in Generate. Model id from fal's model index on 2026-09-11; the adapter is written from the provider's schema and has not run against the live API yet.

fal.note: Text to image only, and the endpoint takes neither a seed nor an output format: both are left out of the request. fal-ai/recraft/v4/pro/text-to-image is the pro tier of the same model.
